module_summary: Destination half of a gray-code CDC FIFO: a pointer child synchronizes the async write pointer and produces read index/valid, and a data child muxes async storage through a spill register to the valid/ready output.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Output data word read from async storage via spill register.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination output valid from data spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination consumer ready popping the output.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Source-side FIFO storage contents read by index in destination domain.

anchors.name: async_wptr_i
anchors.why: Gray write pointer from source domain, synchronized for empty check.

anchors.name: async_rptr_o
anchors.why: Gray read pointer sent back to source domain for full check.

anchors.name: dst_ridx
anchors.why: Read index from pointer logic selecting storage entry.

anchors.name: dst_valid
anchors.why: FIFO non-empty valid from pointer child into data child.

anchors.name: dst_ready
anchors.why: Spill register ready advancing the read pointer.

groups.name: read_pointer
groups.description: Gray read pointer, write-pointer synchronizer and empty detection.

groups.name: read_data
groups.description: Storage read mux and spill register to destination handshake.
